# Corporate    Orders

![Corporate Orders](https://www.dagnedover.com/cdn/shop/files/large-orders-header-update_1200x.jpg?v=12802967176216941235)

## Gifts For The Group

From corporate events and bridal gifts to brand merch and more, Dagne Dover can organize bags for the whole party. Enjoy exclusive perks for bulk orders of 20 pieces or more. Want to make your styles extra special? Let’s chat about customization options for additional cost.

Group chat’s about to go off.

## Let’s Get Started:

If you're a new corporate order client or an existing client placing a customized order, start by filling out our corporate order request form below, and someone from our team will follow up within 2 business days. If you're an existing corporate order client placing a blank (non-customized) order, log in to your account to submit your order request for approval.

Already have a corporate account?

[Corporate Account Login](https://shopify.com/2601439/account)

Corporate & Bulk Order Request Form

## FAQs

Who is the corporate and bulk order program for?



Glad you asked! It’s for anyone looking for lots of Dagne bags. From gifts for family reunions to showering your bridal party with customized bags to gifting for corporate retreats, Dagne bags are a simple way to spread lots of joy. Basically, if you need a bunch of super organized bags, we’ve got your back.


### Customization & Branding

Can I customize your bags with my company’s logo or branding?



Most of our bags can be customized with print or embroidery to make them extra special. When you submit a request, just select “Yes” for customization. We’ll reach out to request your high-resolution logofile (SVG, AI, or EPS format) and provide more details on options.


How long does it take for customization orders to process and ship?



Customized orders typically take up to 4 weeks to process after final design approval and payment. Timelines can vary based on the order size, delivery location, and shipping method.


### Ordering & Pricing

Is there a minimum order quantity for corporate/bulk orders?



Yep! Orders of 20 pieces or more qualify as a bulk order and may be eligible for special pricing.


Do you offer discounts on corporate/bulk orders?



We sure do! Everyone’s order is different, so cost depends on the retail price of the item(s) and how many pieces you’d like.


Can I order a sample?



Definitely! Please fill out our Corporate & Bulk Order Request form and let us know that you’d like a sample. We’ll follow up with your request within 1-2 business days.


How do I place a corporate or bulk order without customization?



1. Log in to your corporate account. If you don't have a corporate account yet, please complete our Corporate Order Request form. A team member will follow up with the next steps.

2. Once logged in, you can browse our curated collection of products eligible for corporate and bulk orders. Corporate order pricing will be displayed on the site.

3. Add the quantity of items you’d like to order to your cart. Note that some items may have minimum order quantities, which will be displayed on our website.

4. Once you're ready, you can submit your order for approval. The approval process takes 1-2 business days.

5. Once approved, you will receive an email with an invoice to complete your purchase.

6. Orders can take up to 7-10 business days to ship. Once shipped, you’ll receive an email with your tracking information.


How long does it take to approve my order request?



Approvals typically take 1-2 business days. If you have an urgent order, please email us at teamcorporateorders@dagnedover.com.


How do I place a customized order?



Please complete the Corporate Order Request form and specify that your request is for a customized order. One of our team members will contact you with next steps.


### Shipping & Fulfillment

What shipping methods are available for customized orders?



We ship using your third-party UPS or FedEx account number and can select either standard or expedited shipping on your behalf. For larger orders that exceed a certain size, we also offer freight (LTL) shipping options. It all depends on what works best for you!


What shipping methods are available for blank orders?



We provide standard ground shipping, which will be charged at checkout. For larger orders that exceed a certain size, we will ship via Freight (LTL).


What is the processing time for corporate/bulk orders?



Once payment is received, processing only takes about 2-3 business days for blank orders. Customized orders may require up to 2-3 weeks to process.


Can corporate/bulk orders be shipped outside of the US?



At this time, corporate/bulk orders can only be shipped within the US.


Do you offer gift wrapping or packaging?



We don’t offer gift wrapping or packaging for corporate/bulk orders. Your wrapping skills are better than ours anyways.


### Payment & Returns

What payment methods are accepted?



We accept payment via credit card.


What is your return and exchange policy for bulk orders?



All corporate/bulk orders are final sale and are not eligible for return or exchange. But no worries, we’ll work together upfront to make sure things are perfect! If there are any issues with your order when it arrives, reach out right away and we’ll help resolve it.
